title: Release audit: The session does not refresh task and release state on its own while the owner i
summary: Poll the engine while waiting for input, for example with a timeout/select loop or a background state-refresh thread, and redraw when the state changes. Add a test that changes stub state between prompts without an owner request and verifies the update becomes visible.
requirements: The session does not refresh task and release state on its own while the owner is idle. `InteractiveSession.run()` refreshes once, prints the prompt and then blocks on `self.input.readline()`; state is re-read only before the next prompt and after a submitted request. If a task or release changes while the owner waits, nothing updates the session. This fails requirement 6 and acceptance 5. The test uses empty input lines to force another loop iteration, so it does not verify idle refresh.
